entries.description: Read planning docs (project-guidance, lessons-learned indexed by reference, session-set-authoring-guide indexed by reference) + spec + suppressions schema + W2 runner suppression-matching reference impl

Audited Dabbler.Uat.Dsl.Cli/Program.cs (validate + compile arg parsing, JSON output shape) and tools/uat-suppressions.json (checklists/errorKind/routePathPatterns schema). Reference matcher: ai-router/uat_runner/runner.py:_split_compile_errors_by_suppressions.
Routed analysis to author ai-assignment.md per Step 3.5
Cross-provider session-verification via opus (cost $0.3962) — note: router selected same-provider opus per existing config behavior; saved review under session-reviews/session-001.md

dotnet build + test in dabbler-uat-dsl: 0 warnings/errors; 150/150 Core tests + 35/35 Emitters tests
Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md, spec.md, Session 1 review

Audited 5 catalog-grounded checklists (uat-dsl-watermark-integration, sensitive-field-masking-audit-uat-remediation, sensitive-field-masking-audit, security-dashboard-uat-followup-fixes, rearchitect-role-administration-dashboard). Every checklist has CLICK INPUT label='Email address' and enter '<email>' at step 2 after /login. No AS ROLE directive seen. Email->role mapping is authoritative in src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/Data/SeedData.cs GetUserRoleAssignments. Runner already has auth_email plumbing via cli.py --auth-email default 'admin@acmecoffee.com'.

Decided: persona-inference path. Reasoning: (a) every catalog-grounded checklist already has the email-in-step pattern at step ~2 -- no author migration needed; (b) no grammar/AST/visitor change reduces blast radius vs directive path; (c) SemanticValidator.Validate(steps, catalog, activeRole) already accepts the parameter -- only the CLI needs to wire --active-role through; (d) email->role mapping lives once in personas.json, derivable from SeedData.cs. Trade-off accepted: less explicit in artifact (reader looks up persona), mitigated by single-file mapping and explicit --active-role override available.

W0 CLI: added --active-role/-r flag to validate+compile in dabbler-uat-dsl/src/Dabbler.Uat.Dsl.Cli/Program.cs and wired it through to SemanticValidator.Validate(steps, catalog, activeRole). Bumped CLI csproj Version to 1.2.1. dabbler-platform: created ai-router/uat_runner/personas.json (email->role map sourced from SeedData.cs GetUserRoleAssignments), added ai-router/uat_runner/personas.py with infer_active_role() helper (5-step lookahead window, returns explicit error for email-not-in-map), wired persona inference into runner.py run_checklist() (new active_role param, _resolve_active_role() helper, --active-role threaded into _invoke_w0_compile cmd), exposed --active-role override on cli.py.

Added 2 SemanticValidatorTests: Validate_ActiveRolePinned_FiltersOutOtherRolesEntries (happy path: SystemAdmin sees Available switch but BackofficeUser does not, with concrete-role error reporting), Validate_ActiveRoleNotInCatalog_ProducesUnknownRouteWithRoleInMessage (clear UnknownRoute error rather than silent miss). Pre-existing Validate_ActiveRoleNull_DefaultsToAnyRoleWildcard already covers no-role-context fallback. Added ai-router/uat_runner/test_cases/test_personas.py with 5 tests: happy_path admin->SystemAdmin, no-signin-step returns no-role-no-error, lookahead window skips late email step, ghost-email returns explicit error naming personas.json, persona map smoke check.
Packed Dabbler.Uat.Dsl.Cli.1.2.1.nupkg into dabbler-uat-dsl/pack-output/. Core+Emitters unchanged (still 1.2.0/1.1.0 in pack-output).

dabbler-uat-dsl: dotnet build clean (0 warnings, 0 errors); dotnet test 187/187 passed (152 Core including 2 new role-pinning tests, 35 Emitters). dabbler-platform: ai-router/uat_runner/test_cases/test_personas.py 5/5 passed. CLI smoke: --active-role SystemAdmin validates the test checklist clean; --active-role GhostRole produces UnknownRoute error with the role name in the message.

Cross-provider session verification: routed task_type=session-verification with complexity_hint=70 — router selected opus (same-provider as orchestrator; same issue noted in Session 1 actuals + lessons-learned 'Cross-provider session-verification needs a fallback ladder, not same-provider escalation'). Cost: $0.7931. Verdict: 'Pass with one cleanup.' All 8 acceptance criteria PASS. Two issues raised; one is a false positive (verifier claims duplicate _invoke_w0_compile but file has exactly one definition at line 171), one is Informational (auth_email vs persona-inference design-debt note, no incorrect behavior). Disagreement on Issue 1 surfaced to human per Step 7 procedure.
